# criblio_monitor_shared_config (Data Source)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_monitor_shared_config" "example" {
  id = "platform-priority"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the shared configuration.

### Read-Only

- `config` (String) Partial monitor configuration carried by this shared configuration.
- `fingerprint` (String) Content hash maintained by the server, used by consumers to detect drift.
- `name` (String) Optional human-readable name for the shared configuration.
